title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Cardmember Agreement: Crediting and Applying Payments
content:
**Crediting date.** A payment to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account is credited as of the day it is received when it arrives online, through the mobile app, the automated phone line, a phone agent or AutoPay by the card's payment cut-off time on a business day (Monday to Friday except Federal Reserve holidays); a payment received after the cut-off or on a non-business day is credited on the next business day. A mail payment is credited on the business day it is received at the payment address, and an in-store payment at a Marlowe & Finch register is credited on the day it is made. The credited date is recorded as the payment's transaction date and is the only date compared with a payment due date.

**Application of the amount.** Payment amounts up to the minimum payment due are applied as the bank chooses; any amount above the minimum payment due is applied first to the balance with the highest APR, except that during the last 2 billing cycles before a special financing promotion expires, the excess is applied first to that promotional balance. A payment never needs to be applied to an amount under open billing dispute.

**Overpayment.** A payment larger than the balance leaves a credit balance, which is handled under the credit balance refund terms.

**Accounts and channels.** Payments are taken on accounts in any status other than applied and declined. Payments are accepted only through the card's payment channels.

## Crediting examples (hypothetical days; cut-off 17:00 Eastern Time)

| Channel | Received | Credited |
|---|---|---|
| online | Wednesday 16:59 ET, a business day | that Wednesday |
| online | Wednesday 17:05 ET | Thursday, the next business day |
| phone agent | Saturday | Monday, when Monday is a business day |
| mail | Tuesday at the payment address | that Tuesday |
| in store at a Marlowe & Finch register | Sunday | that Sunday |

## Allocation example (hypothetical)

A payment exceeds the minimum payment due by USD 300.00 and the account has a special financing balance whose promotion expires after the next billing cycle: the USD 300.00 goes first to that promotional balance. Three billing cycles before expiry, it would go first to the balance with the highest APR.
